title: Just What I Wanted!
text: Just What I Wanted!. I'm getting ready to decorate for fall and this kit of artificial leaves and pumpkins is just what I wanted. The items are as pictured. The quality is good. The price is on par with what I would spend at the local craft store, but the convenience of having it shipped to me is priceless!

product_metadata.title: FLOERVE Fall Decor Kit- Mixture of 60 Artificial Harvest Decoration-6 Colors Fake Maple Leaves, 13 Artificial Pumpkins, 5 Faux Gourd, 10 Fake Acorns, 2 Pinecones for Autumn Thanksgiving Halloween
features: [Packing List] Come with delicate PVC Case, including 2PCs 6cm white pumpkins,3PCs 6cm orange pumpkins,4PCs 5cm white pumpkins, 4PCs 5cm orange pumpkins,3Pcs orange gourd,2PCs yellow gourd,5PCs dark Brown Acorns,5PCs light brown Acorns,2 Pinecones and 6 Colors Maple leaves

[Premium Material] The pumpkins, acorns and gourd are made of dense foam, the maple leaves are made of silk, while the pinecones are natural. They are all eco-friendly, touch real, and durable in use. The pumpkins feature its realistic grooves, small, exquisite, short and wide shapes. Black vein patterns and crease marks add more depth to the leaves

[Eye Catching Style] To meet your various demands, this Autumn Decor Kit provide different pumpkins in various sizes, colors, different harvest decoration in various color. Assorted colors feature white, yellow, orange, red and brown, Decorating your different parties with these, adds a touch of fall and harvest.

[Widely Applied] Our pumpkin decorating kit can be used for dinner tables, backyard, garden, and farmhouse decor. Also be a good idea to decorate autumn theme parties, weddings, celebrations, etc, and most perfectly used for Thanksgiving and Halloween Parties.
[Gift for Thanksgiving and Halloween] Come with a raffia ribbon bow and PVC case, this is an elegant gift for your friends and families.
